content.text: In global mode: each command declares its behavior outside projects (`outsideProject`). Most answer like a new project; some write nothing and name the project they need; `doctor`, `init`, and `upgrade` behave differently. Commands with different behavior describe it in their `In global mode:` note, and CLI tests run each command in an empty folder against its declared value. Inside a project, the project's Astryx release runs every command, whichever astryx command you type. See `astryx docs global`.
